name: TeamStarWolf - Ransomware TTPs
description: Curated practitioner view of ransomware intrusion and extortion behaviors, not an official MITRE mapping and not an attribution to any particular group. Sources: the ATT&CK intrusion-chain table in RANSOMWARE_DEFENSE_REFERENCE.md and data/attack/technique_profiles.jsonl. Includes the reference's explicit initial access, execution, credential access, lateral movement, defense impairment, collection, exfiltration, and impact techniques. Scores indicate membership only, not frequency in incidents.

techniques.comment: Exploiting exposed applications is an initial-access path in the ransomware intrusion chain. Sources: RANSOMWARE_DEFENSE_REFERENCE.md.

Remote Desktop Protocol supports lateral movement between compromised systems. Sources: RANSOMWARE_DEFENSE_REFERENCE.md.
Disabling or modifying security tools reduces defensive visibility before impact. Sources: RANSOMWARE_DEFENSE_REFERENCE.md.
Cloud storage collection can precede extortion-related data theft; its ATT&CK tactic is collection. Sources: RANSOMWARE_DEFENSE_REFERENCE.md.
Web services can transport stolen data for double extortion. Sources: RANSOMWARE_DEFENSE_REFERENCE.md.
Alternative protocols can carry exfiltrated data. Sources: RANSOMWARE_DEFENSE_REFERENCE.md.
Data encryption causes the defining availability impact of ransomware. Sources: RANSOMWARE_DEFENSE_REFERENCE.md.
Recovery inhibition targets backups and restoration mechanisms. Sources: RANSOMWARE_DEFENSE_REFERENCE.md.
Stopping services can interrupt operations and facilitate encryption. Sources: RANSOMWARE_DEFENSE_REFERENCE.md.
